## About
Indianapolis Auto Parts is your local source for quality recycled auto parts, right on N. Raceway Rd in Indianapolis. We're now under new ownership.
Use our search tools to see what we have in stock now, or search by image. Rather talk to someone? Call or stop by our sales department.
Can't find it online? Call us anyway. We'll find it for you, and we can ship it out by UPS or FedEx.

## Services
- Quality recycled auto parts: Used parts for your car or truck from our Indianapolis location.
- 30 & 90 Day Warranties: Offered as part of our service.
- UPS® & FedEx® Shipping: Can't make it to Raceway Rd? We can ship your part.
- Search by Image: Look up a part using a picture.
- Multi-Part Search: Use our Multi-Part Search tool to look up what you need.

Q: What warranties do you offer?
